item: DeepSpot-M head-to-head on the G2-X external section
context: G2-X FAIL (34afa2f: our frozen model, median pathway r -0.1547) + literature calibration (ab1ac6d: DeepSpot-M zero-shot external mean r 0.19, stromal bias concordant). Question: does a 730k-profile 2026 foundation model beat our 29-section internal model RAW on the exact same tissue, and does it show the same stromal-transfer bias?
protocol: same external section: 10x Parent_Visium_Human_BreastCancer (4,325 in-tissue spots, same tissue_positions coords, same image.tif, same 0.75x-pitch 224x224 tiles as G2-X - geometry identical, tiles regenerated by the same code path)

model: pip deepspotm==1.0.0, DeepSpotM.from_pretrained('ratschlab/DeepSpotM', source='scgpt') - scgpt declared the PRIMARY gene-embedding source (single-cell trained, most standard); the other four sources (evo2, orthrus, prott5, apertus) are NOT run (scope discipline; can be a follow-up)
query genes: Hallmark-50 member genes present in BOTH the model's tokens.csv vocabulary AND the internal universe (so frozen z-params apply); pathways with >=5 such genes scored, same >=5 rule

expression scoring: predicted log-scale expression used as-is; pathway score = mean of member-gene values z-scored with the FROZEN internal mu/sd (same transfer rule as G2-X v1.1) - declared: DeepSpot-M's output scale differs from internal log1p-CPM; z-scoring with frozen params is the declared harmonization, no refitting
endpoint: median per-pathway Pearson between DeepSpot-M-derived and observed pathway scores across the same 4,325 spots, over the same pathways

comparison declared: DeepSpot-M median vs our frozen model's -0.1547 (same spots, same endpoint) and vs their published zero-shot external band (mean r 0.19 on 15 Xenium genes); stromal-program analysis: do their stromal pathways (Wnt/Angiogenesis/EMT/Coagulation) also rank top?
no gate: this is a characterization benchmark, not a pass/fail gate - reported either way
compute: GitHub Actions $0 pattern (pinned pip + HF weights download with size check, per-500-spot checkpoint commits, completion guard); CPU estimate 1.5-2.5h for 4,325 tiles
